setup.title: Your space for two
setup.message: Invite your partner in one tap: we set up your space and you send them the link.

pending.waiting: As soon as they join, your space will open.
pending.qrLabel: Invitation QR code, to scan with the camera

active.title: You are together
active.message: Your space for two is ready. Take your time, there is nothing to fill in right now.

join.explain: Enter the 6-character code you received, or paste the message they sent you.
join.invalidFormat: The code has 6 characters (letters and digits).
join.pasteEmpty: No code found in what you copied.

errors.invalid_code: This code does not work. Check it, or ask for a new one.

errors.own_couple: This is your own code: share it with the other person.
errors.already_in_couple: You are already part of a space for two.

together.title: Welcome to {{brand}}
together.body: An app for the two of you, designed so you close it quickly and spend more time together, truly together.

gentle.title: Gentle, never pushy
gentle.body: One question a day, memories to keep, shared organization. Nothing mandatory, nothing to catch up on: you go at your own pace.

never.title: What this app will never do
never.body: Because trust matters more than anything:

items.streaks: No streaks, no points, no couple score.
items.tracking: No location tracking, no “seen at”, no read receipts.
items.ads: No ads, no tracking, no selling of data.
items.private: What you keep to yourself stays yours: the other never sees it.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.nicknameHint: This is what the other person sees. Optional.

coupleInfo.title: Our couple
coupleInfo.currencyHint: 3-letter code, for example EUR, CAD, XOF.
coupleInfo.colorHint: It colours the app for both of you.

memories.emptyMessage: A first time, a place, a laugh: keep what matters to you both.
memories.noMatchMessage: Try another word or clear the filter.

morning.question: How do you feel this morning?
morning.partnerWaiting: {{name}} hasn’t shared their weather yet. No obligation.

advice.joyful: Share the moment with a little word.
advice.happy: A kind word is enough to start the day well.
advice.upset: A simple question: “Can I do something?”
advice.angry: A short word is enough, no speech.
advice.space: Give some space, a short word is enough.
advice.hug: A hug as soon as you can.
advice.listen: Take a moment to listen, without advice.

morning.tooMany: You already answered a few times today.

messages.sendFailed: The message didn’t go. Try again in a moment.
messages.emptyMessage: A word, a photo, a voice note. No “seen”, no “typing”: just you.

distance.title: Where you are
distance.stopMessage: Your location will be erased and {{name}} will no longer see the distance.
distance.waiting: Waiting for {{name}}: the map shows once you both share.
distance.denied: Location is turned off for the app. You can allow it in your phone settings.
distance.error: Your location can’t be read right now.
distance.term1: Your location is read only while the app is open, never in the background.
distance.term2: {{name}} sees the distance between you and your last location on a map, with the time.
distance.term3: Nothing shows until you have both agreed. Nobody else ever sees it.
distance.term4: You can stop at any time: your location is erased right away.
distance.term5: When you are less than 1 km apart, both your phones vibrate to let you know.
distance.continuousHint: Your location is also sent while the app is closed. You get a reminder every 30 days.
distance.continuousDenied: For continuous sharing, choose “Always allow” in your phone’s location settings.
distance.continuousUnavailable: Continuous sharing needs the installed app: it does not work in Expo Go.
distance.serviceBody: Your location is shared with your partner.
distance.nearBody: You are less than a kilometre apart.
